D-35Resume from current main; validate measured wound severity before new trials

+
When
2026-10-24
+
Base
Fresh worktree from origin/main b3fab906. Bring forward the reviewed recovery assay and its stopped 32-pair result as dependencies; preserve the original checkout and its local bundles.
+
Decision
Implement the proposed severity selector and a zero-time feasibility CLI first. The threshold remains at least 30 of 32 saved pairs. A failed threshold ends this protocol before new scientific seeds. Do not soften topology or collateral limits merely to obtain feasible wounds.
+
Review
Use available agy Gemini 4 Argon High for adversarial review, plus the repository-required read-only Sol 6.1 High before committing. Subagents own selector/tests and independent backlog inventory; the coordinator owns evidence loading, decision records and publication.
+
Scope
This is one research slice, not completion of all app prototypes. It leaves simulation physics and the private shared-garden deployment policy unchanged.
+
+
+

D-36Use the current backlog, not the frozen October 18 inventory

+
Evidence
Inventory checked against b3fab906: plans 001–006 are DONE; Gene v2, injuryShell, Pond keeper v3, bell v2, null-stone and sun work have landed. The old prototypes document is explicitly pinned to 5e7bda5c and is not current status.
+
Next slices
After severity feasibility: Pond keeper v3b per-pond shell ranking; explicit island leave/release; operator refusal/pruning counters. Naturalist v3 needs a separate preregistration after the negative v2 result. Shared-garden opening and human playtests remain distinct product/operational decisions and evidence gaps.
+
Sources
Keeper v3 deferred work; Island cancellation; Operator dashboard; Deployment safeguards.
+
